request: Add an ordinal helper (1st, 2nd, 3rd, 11th) for the scoreboard, handling 11–13 correctly, with tests.

summary.result_text:
I couldn't run the tests because the sandbox denied the pytest command, so the new code and tests haven't been run.

`ordinalize` is in `CTFd/utils/humanize/numbers.py`. The scoreboard code in `CTFd/models/__init__.py` (around lines 599 and 857) already imports it from there, but the file was empty. It adds the right suffix (1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th). It gives "th" for 11–13 and for every number ending in 11–13 (111th, 112th, 113th, 1011th). It also accepts numeric strings.

I extended `tests/utils/test_humanize.py` with more cases. It now covers 0, 10–14, 20–23, 100–103, 111–113, 121 and 1011.

The pcat catalog has no ordinal pattern, so I wrote the helper directly.

To check it, run `python -m pytest tests/utils/test_humanize.py -q`.
